subject: Biology
prompt: Which hormone stimulates melanin synthesis in melanocytes?
explain: MSH (melanocyte-stimulating hormone) from intermediate lobe of pituitary stimulates melanin synthesis.

subject: Biology
prompt: Relaxin hormone is secreted by which structure during pregnancy?
explain: Relaxin is secreted by corpus luteum; it relaxes pelvic ligaments and cervix during parturition.

subject: Biology
prompt: Tropic hormones are secreted by which part of pituitary?
explain: Anterior pituitary secretes tropic hormones: TSH, ACTH, FSH, LH that regulate other endocrine glands.

subject: Biology
prompt: Thyroid gland is located in which region of the body?
explain: Thyroid gland is located on the anterior side of the neck, below the larynx, around the trachea.

subject: Biology
prompt: Which hormone inhibits insulin secretion from beta cells?
explain: Somatostatin from delta cells of islets of Langerhans inhibits both insulin and glucagon secretion.

subject: Biology
prompt: Hypothyroidism causes accumulation of which substance in skin?
explain: In myxoedema (adult hypothyroidism), mucopolysaccharides accumulate in skin causing puffy appearance.

subject: Biology
prompt: Which organ is both endocrine and exocrine in females?
explain: Ovary is an endocrine gland (secretes estrogen, progesterone) and also produces eggs (exocrine function).

subject: Biology
prompt: Which hypothalamic hormone stimulates TSH release from pituitary?
explain: TRH (thyrotropin-releasing hormone) from hypothalamus stimulates the anterior pituitary to secrete TSH.

subject: Biology
prompt: Which cells of islets of Langerhans secrete pancreatic polypeptide?
explain: F cells (PP cells) of islets of Langerhans secrete pancreatic polypeptide; NCERT mentions four cell types.

subject: Biology
prompt: Which hormone from anterior pituitary stimulates corpus luteum to secrete progesterone?
explain: LH (luteinizing hormone) maintains corpus luteum and stimulates progesterone secretion post-ovulation.

subject: Biology
prompt: Which ion does aldosterone cause to be excreted in the urine?
explain: Aldosterone promotes Na⁺ reabsorption and K⁺ excretion in renal tubules, regulating blood pressure.

subject: Biology
prompt: Sertoli cells of testis secrete which hormone that inhibits FSH?
explain: Sertoli cells secrete inhibin which acts via negative feedback to inhibit FSH secretion from anterior pituitary.
